meta.name: PanVK Mali-G2 experimental test4 (95230ac)
meta.description: Fixes Eden ASTC shader compilation failure and G2 uniform addressing. Validated compute pipeline creation, ASTC GPU decoding against stock output, Android native images and graphics. Eden integration remains under test.
meta.author: Local G2 port based on JimVulkan mali-panvk

changes: Use canonical ISA encodings so FADD does not match restricted format-conversion aliases
Translate legacy paged FAU operands to G2 flat uniform indices while preserving special-source pages
Separate uniform and special FAU reads when their G2 pages differ
Report build identity and shader allocation in local diagnostics

validation.astc_normal_reference: 3 deterministic inputs, each 16 compressed blocks and 256 RGBA pixels; byte-exact match to stock Vulkan executing original Eden ASTC shader
